question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the highlighted idiom.**

The employee took the manager’s remark **__with a pinch of salt.__**

options.text: Doubt the truth or value of something

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Doubt the truth or value of something.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is** option 3) Doubt the truth or value of something. **
 
• The idiom **"take something with a pinch of salt"** means** to be skeptical or doubtful about the truth or value of something that has been said or claimed (**जो कुछ कहा या दावा किया गया है उसकी सत्यता या मूल्य के बारे में संदेह करना)**.**
 
• In this context, the employee is not taking the manager's remark seriously and is not fully believing it.
 
• Therefore, **option 3** is the most appropriate meaning of the highlighted idiom.

47:T90f,

Here the correct answer is** Option 3.**
